s.n: Lake catfish bites with comeback sauce
s.note: Cornmeal-crusted catfish bites with comeback sauce, fresh from the lake.
s.how: Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon into comeback sauce. Soak the fish in the buttermilk while you mix the cornmeal, flour, paprika and salt. Toss the fish in the cornmeal and fry in hot oil in batches until crisp. Drain, salt and serve with the sauce and lemon.

s.n: Gas station chilli dogs with cheese
s.note: Beef franks smothered in chilli and cheddar.
s.how: Brown the mince with half the onion, add the spices and tomatoes and simmer until thick. Grill the franks until blistered. Fill the rolls, spoon over the chilli and top with cheddar, the rest of the onion and mustard.

m.n: Wood chipper pulled pork rolls with slaw
m.note: Smoky pulled pork and apple slaw.
m.how: Rub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Put it in a lidded pot with the apple juice and cook at 150C until it falls apart. Shred with two forks and stir through the barbecue sauce and some of the juices. Toss the cabbage and apple with the mayonnaise and vinegar. Pile the pork and slaw into the rolls.

m.note: Chargrilled thighs glazed in hot honey.
m.how: Toss the chicken with the oil, paprika, garlic and salt. Warm the honey with the chilli flakes and vinegar and set aside. Grill the chicken and corn over medium-high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through. Brush the chicken with the hot honey for the last few minutes, butter the corn and serve.

w.n: Chamomile honey cake with whipped cream
w.note: Tea-soaked honey cake. Dale throws the chamomile tea at Chad.
w.how: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 10 minutes, then squeeze them out. Beat the butter, sugar and honey until pale, then beat in the eggs. Fold in the flour and the tea, pour into a lined 20cm tin and bake at 170C until a skewer comes out clean. Cool, then serve in wedges with whipped cream and more honey.

d.note: Light American lager in ice-cold cans, one each round the campfire.
d.how: Bury the cans in ice in the esky. Crack one each and pass them round the fire.
